confirm_delete_template: Are you sure you want to delete the template "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
date_range_required: Both start and end dates are required
end_date_before_start_date: End date must be after start date
even_odd_template_explanation: Even/Odd templates use 2 weeks: one for even ISO weeks and one for odd ISO weeks.
merge_template_assignments_warning: Template assignments will be added to existing assignments without deleting them.
merge_template_demands_warning: Template demands will be added to existing demands without deleting them.
no_templates_description: Create your first template to save and reuse schedule patterns.
overwrite_template_assignments_warning: This will delete existing assignments for the template shifts in the selected date range before applying.
overwrite_template_demands_warning: This will delete existing demands in the selected date range before applying.
standard_template_explanation: Standard template cycles through its weeks repeatedly over the target period.
template_description_placeholder: Enter a description for this template (optional)
scope_dialog_description: Select which work shifts are affected by this template. Shifts not in scope will be hidden from the template and unaffected when applied.
scope_deselect_warning: This shift has demand entries or worker assignments in the template. Removing it from scope will permanently delete this data.
